_about: MeshAi settings shared by every machine. Put this machine's own paths in server/settings.local.json (git-ignored); it is laid over this file.
_trellis_dir: The TRELLIS.2 Mac port (github.com/shivampkumar/trellis-mac), set up with its own .venv and a local-model/ folder. Relative to this tool's folder (apps/3d, so ../../../trellis-mac sits beside Ai-Hub), or a full path.
_references: Models to compare others with (the model page's Compare, on a wide screen), each {name, path to a .glb}. Set in settings.local.json, since they're this machine's files (for example a game's main character).
_idle_minutes: TRELLIS uses about 18 GB while loaded. After this many minutes with nothing to do it is let go; the next job loads it again (about a minute).
_pipeline_type: 512 is the one that works reliably on a Mac (1024 crashed for others).
_folders: Folders the Bulk tab may look in: [{"name": "Desktop", "path": "~/Desktop"}]. Set them in settings.local.json.
